issues.message: SQL query built by string concatenation
issues.impact: An attacker controls part of the query and can read or change other rows.
issues.evidence: Line 5 concatenates uid into the SQL string instead of binding it.
issues.suggestion: Bind uid as a query parameter.
issues.verification: Re-run the review; the finding disappears once uid is bound.

suggestions.title: Parameterize the query
suggestions.description: Replace the concatenation with a bound parameter.
suggestions.current_code:
query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = " + uid
    return connect().execute(query)
suggestions.proposed_code:
query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?"
    return connect().execute(query, (uid,))
suggestions.rationale: Removes the injection path without changing the result for valid ids.
suggestions.verification: Re-run the review and confirm the SQL injection finding is gone.

summary: The change builds a SQL query by concatenation instead of binding the id.
